definitions.gloss: bad influence; harmful effect; adverse impact
definitions.explanation: A negative effect that something has on a person, situation, or environment.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}に{悪影響|あくえいきょう}がある。
examples.english: It has a bad effect on health.

examples.japanese: スマホの{使|つか}いすぎは{子供|こども}に{悪影響|あくえいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: Excessive smartphone use has a harmful effect on children.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}{汚染|おせん}が{生態系|せいたいけい}に{悪影響|あくえいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼしていることが{明|あき}らかになった。
examples.english: It became clear that environmental pollution is having an adverse impact on the ecosystem.

notes:
{悪影響|あくえいきょう} means bad influence or harmful effect. Frequently used in news, health, education, and environmental discussions.

FORMS:
{悪|あく} (bad) + {影響|えいきょう} (influence, effect). The opposite is {好影響|こうえいきょう} (positive influence), though this is less commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪影響|あくえいきょう}を{与|あた}える: to have a bad influence on
- {悪影響|あくえいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす: to exert a harmful effect on (more formal)
- {悪影響|あくえいきょう}が{出|で}る: harmful effects appear
- {悪影響|あくえいきょう}を{受|う}ける: to be affected negatively

TYPICAL TOPICS:
- {健康|けんこう}への{悪影響|あくえいきょう}: harmful effects on health
- {環境|かんきょう}への{悪影響|あくえいきょう}: adverse impact on the environment
- {子供|こども}への{悪影響|あくえいきょう}: bad influence on children
